ios.desc:
Conduct intersection studies without the clunky hassle of expensive TMC boards. Get started for FREE today with no signups and full access to data collection.

With Traffic Count, you can:
- Record from your iPhone or iPad with audible and haptic feedback, no need to look down
- Work together with another and import/combine your data
- Export via Email, AirDrop, iCloud, OneDrive, and more
- Integrate into your existing workflows through PetraPro and Synchro compatible files
- Generate PDF diagrams and customized spreadsheets


TRUSTED BY:
• Civil engineering professionals
• State & municipal governments
• Small business owners
• Non-profit environmental organizations
• Students


-----------------------
Features:

4 CLASSES + PEDS + UTURNS
• Four vehicle banks: cars, bikes, and light and heavy trucks
• Track pedestrians moving both ways in crosswalks
• Separate uturn button

PETRAPRO COMPATIBILITY
• Save as enhanced turning movement count
• Will include all classes w/ peds + uturns

UTDF OUTPUT
• Compatible with Synchro and other timing software
• Produces Volume.csv file

SIMPLE CUSTOMIZED SPREADSHEETS
• Choose time intervals of 1,5,6,10,15,20,30,60 minutes
• Trim the starting/ending times
• Compile into the universal .csv format
• Easy integration with Microsoft Excel or other data analysis tools

MORE FILE FORMATS
• Include a PDF diagram of the intersection for quick reference
• Send a Traffic Count (.tc) file to premium users, and they can import/handle the data
• Compress into a .zip


-----------------------
Available with Premium:

COLLABORATE WITH OTHERS
• Import a Traffic Count (.tc) file via Email, Files, Airdrop, etc.
• Save, edit, and export the study data yourself later
• Have 2 or more users work together at the same intersection
• Send someone into the field with the free version on their device

MERGE STUDY DATA
• Combine 2 or more studies into 1
• Data could be collected concurrently or at different times

RETRIEVE ALL PREVIOUS STUDIES
• No need to export data right away
• Take/import as many counts as you like and access later
• Access all studies recorded with the free version

EXPORT ALL FILE FORMATS
• Create PDF, JPG, CSV, JCD, and UTDF


==============================

I went super niche with an iOS vehicle counting board for civil engineers to conduct intersection studies, https://apps.apple.com/us/app/traffic-count-tmc/id1553635289

I never did any advertising and it was gaining traction, but lately plateaued at a handful of downloads / day. Not sure where would be a good place to spread the word haha.
